---- MODULE W4Od13m5p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Vals == {1, 2, 3}
Quorum == 2

VARIABLES rec, ver, applied, prop, votes, crashed

vars == <<rec, ver, applied, prop, votes, crashed>>

NoProp == [active |-> FALSE, val |-> 0, id |-> 0]

Init ==
    /\ rec = 0
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ prop = NoProp
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

Propose(v) ==
    /\ ~prop.active
    /\ ver < 3
    /\ prop' = [active |-> TRUE, val |-> v, id |-> ver + 1]
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, ver, applied, crashed>>

Vote(n) ==
    /\ prop.active
    /\ n \notin crashed
    /\ n \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, ver, applied, prop, crashed>>

Crash(n) ==
    /\ n \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 1
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, ver, applied, prop, votes>>

Commit ==
    /\ prop.active
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ rec' = prop.val
    /\ ver' = prop.id
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {[id |-> prop.id, val |-> prop.val]}
    /\ prop' = NoProp
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Abort ==
    /\ prop.active
    /\ Cardinality(Nodes \ crashed) < Quorum
    /\ prop' = NoProp
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, ver, applied, crashed>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ ~prop.active
    /\ ver >= 3
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Vals : Propose(v)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Vote(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Quiesce

TypeOK ==
    /\ rec \in 0..3
    /\ ver \in 0..3
    /\ prop.active \in BOOLEAN
    /\ votes \subseteq Nodes
    /\ crashed \subseteq Nodes

NoLostUpdate ==
    /\ ((ver = 0) <=> (applied = {}))
    /\ ((ver > 0) => (\E e \in applied : e.id = ver /\ e.val = rec))
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A regional vending-machine network keeps one shared inventory record that any
machine may update. To prevent conflicting writes, every proposed update to the
record must first win a quorum vote among the machines before it is applied.
A machine proposes a new record value; other machines cast approving votes; once
a majority (two of three) have approved, the update commits, the record takes the
new value, and a monotonic version number advances so the applied write is logged.
Any single machine may crash silently at any moment: a crashed machine casts no
further votes. If a crash makes a majority unreachable, the pending proposal is
aborted and cleared so a fresh proposal can start. Votes already cast before a
crash still count. Once the record reaches its final version and no proposal is
pending, the network simply idles.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The record's current value always equals the value of the most
recent committed update at the current version, so no committed write is ever lost.

NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A container-ship crane yard coordinates access to a single critical loading bay
using leases with expiry. A crane requests a grant while the bay is unleased; the
grant is queued as a message carrying an expiry time. Grant messages may be
delivered out of order, and any delivered while the bay is already leased are
dropped as stale. When a grant is delivered to a free lease, that crane becomes
the lease holder until its expiry. Only the current lease holder, and only before
its lease expires, may enter the bay. A crane exits the bay and releases the
lease. An expired lease is reclaimed only once its former holder has left the bay,
after which a fresh grant can be issued. A shift clock ticks forward, and once the
clock reaches the end of the shift the yard idles.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one crane occupies the critical loading bay at any time.

NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityOK
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line uses a token ring to decide which entry station may put a
car onto the shared conveyor. The stations are arranged in a ring and pass a
single token among themselves; only the station currently holding the token may
admit a waiting car onto the conveyor, and only while the conveyor is below its
capacity. Cars arrive and wait in a holding queue before admission. At the far end

another live station. Any single non-holding station may crash silently and is
then skipped when the token is passed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of cars on the conveyor never exceeds its fixed capacity.

share one settlement ledger, the critical resource. Access is arbitrated by a
token ring: a single token circulates among the banks, and only the token holder

INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A print shop job spooler grants exclusive access to a single physical printer.
Configuration is versioned by an epoch number: whenever the spooler is
reconfigured the epoch advances and any outstanding lock grant is invalidated. A
worker registers a request; the spooler grants the lock, stamping it with the
current epoch. A worker may begin printing only if it holds the lock, the lock's
epoch still matches the current epoch, and the printer is idle; it releases the
lock when finished. A privileged admin override lets the shop administrator seize
the idle printer directly, bypassing the epoch and lock machinery, and release it
afterward.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one actor is printing on the shared printer at any time.

vars == <<reg, done, cap, queued>>

Init ==
    /\ reg = [j \in Jobs |-> NONE]
    /\ done = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ queued = 0

Claim(w, j) ==
    /\ reg[j] = NONE

    /\ reg[j] = w
    /\ done[j] = 0
    /\ queued <= cap
    /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![j] = 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, cap, queued>>

Release(j) ==
    /\ reg[j] # NONE
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![j] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<done, cap, queued>>

SetCap(k) ==
    /\ k # cap
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, done, queued>>

Enqueue ==
    /\ queued < MaxQ
    /\ queued' = queued + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, done, cap>>

    /\ queued > 0
    /\ queued' = queued - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, done, cap>>

NEXT Next
INVARIANT FinalizeAtMostOnce
nl:

worker earns the exclusive right to finalize a job. Finalizing a job is
irreversible and must happen at most once per job. A worker claims a job by
compare-and-swapping the job's register from empty to itself, which only one
worker can win. The claiming worker may finalize the job only if it still holds
the register, the job has not yet been finalized, and the current backlog fits
within the spool capacity. A claim may be released, returning the register to
empty. The spool capacity changes at runtime, and jobs are enqueued and dequeued
from the backlog independently.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Each job is finalized at most once.

    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]

    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]

    /\ \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)

independent shedder instances draw from that same pool, creating a double-
allocation hazard. Each instance allocates a slot using two-phase commit. To begin,
an idle instance picks an unowned, unlocked slot and takes a prepare-lock on it,
entering the preparing phase. Each participant then votes for the transaction; once
all participants have voted, the instance commits, becoming the slot's owner. An
instance may instead abort a preparing transaction, releasing its prepare-lock. A
committed instance finishes by releasing its prepare-lock while retaining
ownership. When both instances are idle and every slot is owned, the shedder idles.

prepare-locked by a different instance, so no slot is double-allocated.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m8p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Routers == {"r1", "r2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxCap == 2

VARIABLES coarse, fineLock, claims, cap

vars == <<coarse, fineLock, claims, cap>>

AllocCount == Cardinality({s \in Slots : claims[s] # NONE})

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fineLock = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ claims = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ cap = 2

AcquireCoarse(r) ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, claims, cap>>

AcquireFine(r, s) ==
    /\ coarse = r
    /\ fineLock[s] = NONE
    /\ claims[s] = NONE
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![s] = r]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, claims, cap>>

Commit(r, s) ==
    /\ fineLock[s] = r
    /\ claims[s] = NONE
    /\ AllocCount < cap
    /\ claims' = [claims EXCEPT ![s] = r]
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, cap>>

ReleaseCoarse(r) ==
    /\ coarse = r
    /\ \A s \in Slots : fineLock[s] # r
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, claims, cap>>

Free(r, s) ==
    /\ claims[s] = r
    /\ claims' = [claims EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fineLock, cap>>

SetCap(k) ==
    /\ k # cap
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fineLock, claims>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Routers : AcquireCoarse(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers, s \in Slots : AcquireFine(r, s)
    \/ \E r \in Routers, s \in Slots : Commit(r, s)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : ReleaseCoarse(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers, s \in Slots : Free(r, s)
    \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : SetCap(k)

    /\ coarse \in Routers \cup {NONE}
    /\ fineLock \in [Slots -> Routers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ claims \in [Slots -> Routers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap

    \A s \in Slots : fineLock[s] # NONE => fineLock[s] = coarse
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
An airport baggage router allocates chute slots using hierarchical locks taken
coarse-then-fine to avoid double-allocating a slot. A router first acquires the
coarse zone lock, which only one router may hold. Holding the coarse lock, it takes
a fine lock on a specific, currently unowned slot, then commits the allocation,
becoming the slot's owner and releasing the fine lock, provided the number of
allocated slots is still below the current capacity. A router may release the
coarse lock only once it holds no fine locks, preserving the coarse-then-fine
ordering. Owned slots may later be freed. The allocation capacity changes at
runtime as terminal load varies.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A fine lock on a slot is only ever held by the router that
currently holds the coarse zone lock, so two routers can never concurrently
allocate the same slot.

---- MODULE W4Od12m0p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Instances == {"i1", "i2"}
NIL == -1
MaxV == 4
MaxPool == 3

vars == <<inCS, version, snapshot, pool>>

Init ==
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ version = 0
    /\ snapshot = [i \in Instances |-> NIL]
    /\ pool = MaxPool

Begin(i) ==
    /\ snapshot[i] = NIL
    /\ snapshot' = [snapshot EXCEPT ![i] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, version, pool>>

Enter(i) ==
    /\ snapshot[i] = version
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ version < MaxV
    /\ inCS' = {i}
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ snapshot' = [snapshot EXCEPT ![i] = NIL]
    /\ UNCHANGED pool

Retry(i) ==
    /\ snapshot[i] # NIL
    /\ snapshot[i] # version
    /\ snapshot' = [snapshot EXCEPT ![i] = NIL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, version, pool>>

Dispense(i) ==
    /\ i \in inCS
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, version, snapshot>>

Exit(i) ==
    /\ i \in inCS
    /\ version < MaxV
    /\ inCS' = {}
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snapshot, pool>>

Idle ==
    /\ version = MaxV
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Begin(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Enter(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Retry(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Dispense(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Exit(i)
    \/ Idle

    /\ version \in 0..MaxV
    /\ snapshot \in [Instances -> {NIL} \cup (0..MaxV)]
    /\ pool \in 0..MaxPool

====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker has two independent instances that dispense from
one shared inventory pool, and at most one instance may be inside the dispensing
critical section at a time. Entry is coordinated by optimistic locking with retry
over a version number. An instance begins by snapshotting the current version. It
enters the critical section only if its snapshot still matches the version and the
section is empty, which bumps the version and clears its snapshot; if the version
has since moved, its attempt is stale and it retries. While inside, an instance
may dispense a unit from the shared pool. Exiting the section also bumps the
version. Once the version reaches its bound the tracker idles.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one instance is inside the dispensing critical section at
any time.

clears leadership so a new leader can be elected in a later term. Elevators request
the express shaft and wait. Only the elected leader may grant the shaft, and only

releases the shaft. Once the final term is reached with no leader, the bank idles.

---- MODULE W4Od14m7p5t5 ----

Drones == {"d1", "d2"}
Targets == {"g1", "g2"}
NONE == "none"
ADMIN == "admin"

    /\ dropped = [t \in Targets |-> 0]
    /\ armed = [t \in Targets |-> FALSE]
    /\ droppedBy = [t \in Targets |-> NONE]

Claim(d, t) ==
    /\ reg[t] = NONE
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![t] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dropped, armed, droppedBy>>

Arm(d, t) ==
    /\ reg[t] = d
    /\ ~armed[t]
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![t] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, dropped, droppedBy>>

Drop(d, t) ==
    /\ reg[t] = d
    /\ armed[t]
    /\ dropped[t] = 0
    /\ dropped' = [dropped EXCEPT ![t] = 1]
    /\ droppedBy' = [droppedBy EXCEPT ![t] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, armed>>

Release(t) ==
    /\ reg[t] # NONE
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dropped, droppedBy>>

AdminDrop(t) ==
    /\ dropped[t] = 0
    /\ dropped' = [dropped EXCEPT ![t] = 1]
    /\ droppedBy' = [droppedBy EXCEPT ![t] = ADMIN]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, armed>>

    \/ \E d \in Drones, t \in Targets : Arm(d, t)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, t \in Targets : Drop(d, t)

NEXT Next
INVARIANT DropAtMostOnce
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm can release a retardant drop on a target, an
irreversible action that must happen at most once per target. The exclusive right
to drop on a target is held via a per-target compare-and-swap register. A drone
claims a target by swapping its register from empty to itself, which only one drone
can win. The claiming drone arms the target, then drops on it only if it still
holds the register, the target is armed, and no drop has yet occurred, recording
which drone dropped. A claim, along with its armed state, may be released. A
privileged incident commander override may drop directly on any undropped target,
bypassing the register and arming, recorded as an admin drop.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Each target receives at most one retardant drop.

---- MODULE W4Od9m7p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Shedders == {"a1", "a2"}
NONE == "none"
Cap == 3
Amounts == {1, 2}

VARIABLES reg, shed, pending, phase

vars == <<reg, shed, pending, phase>>

Init ==
    /\ reg = NONE
    /\ shed = 0
    /\ pending = [s \in Shedders |-> 0]
    /\ phase = [s \in Shedders |-> "idle"]

Claim(s) ==
    /\ reg = NONE
    /\ phase[s] = "idle"
    /\ reg' = s
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "claimed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shed, pending>>

Prepare(s, k) ==
    /\ reg = s
    /\ phase[s] = "claimed"
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![s] = k]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "prepared"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, shed>>

Commit(s) ==
    /\ reg = s
    /\ phase[s] = "prepared"
    /\ shed + pending[s] <= Cap
    /\ shed' = shed + pending[s]
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ reg' = NONE

Abort(s) ==
    /\ reg = s
    /\ phase[s] \in {"claimed", "prepared"}
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ reg' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED shed

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Shedders : Claim(s)
    \/ \E s \in Shedders, k \in Amounts : Prepare(s, k)
    \/ \E s \in Shedders : Commit(s)
    \/ \E s \in Shedders : Abort(s)

    /\ reg \in Shedders \cup {NONE}
    /\ shed \in 0..(Cap + 2)
    /\ pending \in [Shedders -> 0..2]
    /\ phase \in [Shedders -> {"idle", "claimed", "prepared"}]

CapacityOK == shed <= Cap
====

NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityOK

never exceed the shedding budget. Exclusive shedding rights are serialized through
a single compare-and-swap register. A shedder claims the register by swapping it
from empty to itself, which only one shedder can win. The claiming shedder prepares
an amount to shed, then commits it, which is applied to the running shed total only
if it still fits within the budget, after which the register is released. A shedder
may be arbitrarily slow between preparing and committing but never fails; it may
also abort, releasing the register without shedding.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total load shed never exceeds the shedding budget.

---- MODULE W4Od6m5p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

    /\ phase = "idle"

    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ occupancy < Cap
    /\ occupancy' = occupancy + 1
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ proposer' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

    /\ occupancy' = occupancy - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, phase, proposer>>

    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Vote(c)
    \/ Admit

    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}
    /\ proposer \in Instances \cup {NONE}

====

occupancy must never exceed its capacity. Two independent dispatcher instances draw
from and add to this one shared staging pool. Admitting an elevator requires quorum
approval from the bank controllers. A dispatcher instance proposes an admission,
opening a voting round; controllers then cast approving votes. Once a quorum of
votes is reached and the staging area is below capacity, the elevator is admitted,
raising occupancy and closing the round. Elevators depart the staging area over
time, lowering occupancy.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The staging area occupancy never exceeds its capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od11m7p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Workers == {"w1", "w2"}
NONE == "none"
TotalN == 3

VARIABLES incoming, printing, done, reg, crashed

vars == <<incoming, printing, done, reg, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ incoming = TotalN
    /\ printing = 0
    /\ done = 0
    /\ reg = NONE
    /\ crashed = {}

Acquire(w) ==
    /\ reg = NONE
    /\ w \notin crashed
    /\ reg' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<incoming, printing, done, crashed>>

StartPrint(w) ==
    /\ reg = w
    /\ incoming > 0
    /\ incoming' = incoming - 1
    /\ printing' = printing + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<done, reg, crashed>>

FinishPrint(w) ==
    /\ reg = w
    /\ printing > 0
    /\ printing' = printing - 1
    /\ done' = done + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<incoming, reg, crashed>>

Release(w) ==
    /\ reg = w
    /\ reg' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<incoming, printing, done, crashed>>

Crash(w) ==
    /\ w # reg
    /\ w \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 1
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<incoming, printing, done, reg>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Acquire(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : StartPrint(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : FinishPrint(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Release(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Crash(w)

    /\ incoming \in 0..TotalN
    /\ printing \in 0..TotalN
    /\ done \in 0..TotalN
    /\ reg \in Workers \cup {NONE}
    /\ crashed \subseteq Workers

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A print shop job spooler moves a fixed batch of jobs through three stages,
incoming, printing, and done, and no job is ever created or destroyed as it moves.
Transfers between stages are serialized by a single compare-and-swap register that
grants one worker exclusive transfer rights at a time. A worker acquires the
register by swapping it from empty to itself, then may move one job from incoming
to printing, or one job from printing to done, and finally releases the register. A
single worker that is not currently holding the register may crash silently and is
thereafter excluded from acquiring it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of jobs across the incoming, printing, and done
stages always equals the original batch size.

currently elected leader may carry out; a stale leader from an earlier term or any

varies.

legitimately won leadership for that term, never by a stale or unauthorized worker.
